channel.title: New Straits Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from New Straits Times (nst.com.my)

item.title: China executes 11 linked to Myanmar scam compounds
item.description: BEIJING: China executed 11 people linked to Myanmar criminal gangs, including “key members” of telecom scam operations, state media reported Thursday, as Beijing toughens its response to the sprawling, transnational industry.

item.title: Google disrupts large proxy network to prevent exploitation by cybercriminals, hackers
item.description: CALIFORNIA: Google said on Wednesday it has taken action to remove domains belonging to one of the largest residential proxy networks in the world, called IPIDEA, to protect millions of consumer devices from being exploited by cybercriminals and state-sponsored hackers.

item.title: #SHOWBIZ: Drumming to a different beat: Khalifah's Tony proud of sanitation work
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Serving the community is a noble calling, and veteran drummer Tony of the rock band Khalifah is taking that sentiment to heart.

item.title: Police warn against open burning after bush fire near Muslim cemetery
item.description: MUAR: Police issued a stern warning against open burning after a bush fire engulfed nearly one hectare of bushes near a Muslim cemetery here on Monday.

item.title: Op Pedo suspect faces human trafficking charges on top of sex offences
item.description: JOHOR BARU: A 29-year-old technician has been hit with a series of human trafficking charges, adding to an existing string of sexual offence charges following a major investigation codenamed Op Pedo.

item.title: Ex-chairman pleads not guilty to misappropriating RM485,500
item.description: KOTA BARU: A former mining company executive chairman was charged at the Sessions Court today with 13 counts of misappropriating RM485,500 belonging to Syarikat Dutamas Hijau Sdn Bhd (DHSB) seven years ago.

item.title: 'No. 1 fan': Rapper Minaj backs Trump [WATCH]
item.description: Washington, United States: Rap icon Nicki Minaj declared Wednesday she was Donald Trump’s “number one fan,” adding that “hate” directed at the US president made her support him more.

item.title: 1,520 police deployed for Thaipusam at Batu Caves
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: A total of 1,520 police officers and personnel will be mobilised to ensure public safety and smooth traffic flow around Batu Caves in conjunction with the Thaipusam festival this Sunday.

item.title: Penang CM: Coastal erosion not caused by land reclamation, mitigation works underway
item.description: GEORGE TOWN: Recent coastal erosion along the northern corridor, including Batu Ferringhi, Tanjung Bungah and Tanjung Tokong, is not linked to land reclamation or overdevelopment.

item.title: Pas opposed to proposed changes to PN structure, says Takiyuddin
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Pas will not agree to any proposed changes to Perikatan Nasional’s structure, including the abolishment of the PN chairman’s post, says Datuk Seri Takiyuddin Hassan.
